svg.title: 人如何通过提示词驱动 AI 生成、验证和交接制品
svg.desc: 人给目标和约束，执行AI读取事实，必要时呈现方案供人选择，之后调用工具生成制品。独立验证AI读取固定标准和候选取得证据。缺陷回到执行AI修复，涉及新业务决定由人确认。交接前写入版本、结果和未决事项。

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif;

svg.text: 启动提示词：目标、约束、输入位置、预期制品

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 读取 AGENTS、已确认规格、任务与当前状态

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 可核对的事实、版本和已有证据

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 澄清问题、备选方案、影响与建议

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 选择 / 纠正提示词：决定及适用范围

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 记录真实决定来源，更新规格或 ADR

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 实际生成 / 修改 / 运行：文档、代码、测试、构建

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 候选制品、自检结果与原始证据

svg.text: 验证提示词：确认标准、固定候选、检查范围

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 只读实现，执行检查并核对版本与证据

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 实际结果、日志、截图和数据变化

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 保存验收报告和对应版本证据

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 通过 / 失败 / 无法判定 / 阻塞，解释依据

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 修订提示词，或沿用已授权的修复范围

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 修订受影响制品，标记相关证据待重验

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 新候选与原判据，继续验证

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 重验结果；未通过继续修订

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 交接提示词：保存确认结果与下一步

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 固化版本、上下文、证据、风险与未决事项
每个阶段共用的人驱动 AI 协作循环
